summary: Implemented the authenticated API-backed SEK-07 seeker notifications screen with server-owned unread counts, pagination, unread filtering, mark-as-read and mark-all-read actions, safe deep links, localized Arabic/English/Simplified Chinese rendering, and desktop visual/accessibility interaction coverage.

verification.notes: Web source and test lint passed with zero warnings.
Focused notification component/adapter suite passed 6/6 tests, including all supported directions, safe projection, query serialization, read/read-all actions, empty, and anonymous states.
Complete web suite passed: 22 Vitest files/142 tests and 76 TAP tests.
Client and SSR production bundles built successfully; Vite emitted only the existing chunk-size advisory.
Generated the three SEK-07 localized desktop visual baselines; notification list, filtering, read/read-all, empty, permission, deep-link, focus, and safe-projection flows passed 9/9.
Clean visual and interaction verification passed 9/9 across Arabic RTL, English LTR, and Simplified Chinese LTR at the approved Desktop scope.
Notification API and shared contract typecheck passed.
API unit suite passed 343/343 tests, including notification ownership and safe projection coverage.
API route suite passed 79/79 tests, including seeker notification authentication, unread filtering, read/read-all, and strict query coverage.
GET /api/v1/seeker/notifications, POST /api/v1/seeker/notifications/:notificationId/read, and POST /api/v1/seeker/notifications/read-all are inventoried as implemented.
Agent Pack audit was clean before closure; frontend_034 was the only in-progress task.

sourceEvidence: Runtime routes GET/POST /api/v1/seeker/notifications, /api/v1/seeker/notifications/:notificationId/read, and /api/v1/seeker/notifications/read-all with operation IDs listSeekerNotifications, markSeekerNotificationRead, and markAllSeekerNotificationsRead.

API authentication, recipient ownership, safe projection, and no-store behavior apps/api/src/modules/notifications/router.ts, apps/api/src/modules/notifications/service.ts, and apps/api/src/modules/notifications/repository.ts.
scopeNotes: The direct route integration in apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx is the necessary integration exception outside the task's listed Allowed Roots.
The dashboard is implemented for the approved Desktop-only SEK-07 scope; no Tablet or Mobile dashboard frame or behavior was invented.

The component renders only the notification contract's localized title/message, safe link, type, readAt, and createdAt fields; icons are bounded type cues and do not fabricate provider, user, avatar, audit, or moderation data.
The visual checks used deterministic test-only route fixtures and never changed Production runtime data or API behavior.
